wispr.voice.hotkey.description: The existing hotkey configured in official Wispr Flow. This observes the shortcut without registering or replacing it.

wispr.voice.preferredAgent.description: Try this installed CLI first, then another signed-in CLI if it is unavailable.

wispr.voice.autoSend.description: Automatically route verified Flow-owned transcript updates after the configured hotkey while Wispr ID is focused.

wispr.voice.codexPath.description: Optional installed Codex executable path. Prompts are never interpolated into shell commands.

wispr.voice.claudePath.description: Optional installed Claude Code executable path.

wispr.voice.model.description: Exact model advertised by the installed Codex account. Unavailable requested models are never silently substituted.

wispr.voice.reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort advertised for the selected model. Low corresponds to light reasoning.
